support.notes: Windows settings can select DJI Mic 2 and report a real recording endpoint, but continuous recording and transmitter-control mapping are not yet accepted on real hardware.

transports.notes: DJI officially documents connecting the receiver to a computer by USB-C. Device enumeration and channel behavior must be verified on each desktop platform.

Windows 11 real-device evidence confirms the transmitter can expose the standard Bluetooth HFP Hands-Free recording path. Availability remains platform/device-state dependent and is verified by the audio-input endpoint, not pairing alone.

protocols.notes: No undocumented Bluetooth or control protocol is claimed or implemented.

platforms.notes: The existing CoreAudio input selector can route a user-selected DJI Mic 2 input; device-specific detection and real-device acceptance are in progress.

Windows Bluetooth HFP identity and recording endpoints are confirmed on real hardware. A dedicated selectable settings page and endpoint diagnostics are implemented as a build candidate; continuous recording and physical-control acceptance remain pending.
Start with receiver-over-USB audio enumeration; Bluetooth is a separate research path.
